name: Staff of the Magi
body:
This staff has 50 charges and can be wielded as a magic Quarterstaff that grants a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with it. While you hold it, you gain a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls.

**Spell Absorption.** While holding the staff, you have Advantage on saving throws against spells.

**Regaining Charges.** The staff regains 4d6 + 2 expended charges daily at dawn.

name: Staff of the Python
body: As a Magic action, you can throw this staff so that it lands in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of you, causing the staff to become a Giant Constrictor Snake in that space.
